text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Ruler. Today, Pisa and I have prepared a 
lateral thinking puzzle for you.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Oho, from you two? Sounds fun. Very well, 
lay it on me.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Then let's get right into it!♪ "On a 
certain day, an Umamusume went vastly over 
her daily calorie limit, yet she was 
thrilled. Why?"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—Hmm. Did that Umamusume "eat too much of 
her favorite food"?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
No. I did not eat only my favorite foods, 
nor did I overeat excessively.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hoh... So, did you "reach some goal", like 
speed eating or competitive eating?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
No. It seems they didn't have any 
particular goal in mind.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. It's not a favorite food, nor does 
she have a goal... Yet, taking in those 
calories—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—! The Umamusume, "it was her birthday on 
that day"?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Splendid, Ruler. Indeed, today is your 
birthday—my heartfelt congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I've prepared plenty of sandwiches too♪ At 
least for today, let's not worry about 
calories and eat as much as we want!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes! I shall enjoy this to my heart's 
content! Heheheh...! Thank you for such an 
intriguing quiz!
